node: AI data-center grid interconnection, transformers, switchgear, and transmission services
summary: Layer 1B expanded the node from obvious electrical-equipment leaders into smaller or less AI-labeled public companies tied to medium-voltage switchgear, transformer capacity, grid-stability equipment, and electrical contracting. The highest-quality underfollowed leads for later verification are Powell Industries for custom switchgear and data-center orders, AMSC for newly acquired transformer exposure plus grid resiliency products, and MYR Group for transmission/distribution and data-center electrical contracting. Eaton is retained only as a reference anchor because it is a well-covered mega-cap leader rather than the main discovery target.
